blob-archive-review.name: blob-archive-review
blob-archive-review.prompt: Read-only review the snapshot patch `pool-review-inputs/blob-archive.patch` against this repository at the pinned base. It is the exact diff from Blob archive session commit 1f397b1c, exported relative to base d1fa804403ea6218b717c0d8c7116903f06145ca. Review backup/archive/recovery correctness, consistency and crash/retry behavior, concurrency, error handling, API/docs alignment, and tests. Treat claims in docs as unverified unless code/tests demonstrate them; preserve existing HA and production gates. Do not edit or integrate code. Produce a concise Markdown report with actionable findings first, each including severity, confidence (1-10), exact changed file and line evidence (derive line numbers from patch/context), impact, and focused remediation. If none, say so and list scope examined.
blob-archive-review.title: Review HA Blob archive session patch

gateway-review.name: gateway-review
gateway-review.prompt: Perform a read-only implementation review of VLite HA ITEM-014, ITEM-015, and ITEM-016 on the pinned base. Inspect their source, tests, documentation, and PRD acceptance/status. Identify only actionable correctness, reliability, or contract gaps; distinguish actual defects from explicitly open decisions, measurement limits, and deployment gates. Do not change files or propose bypassing any gate. Write a concise Markdown report with findings first, each including severity, confidence (1-10), exact file:line evidence, impact, and a focused remediation direction. If none, state that and list the main scope examined.
gateway-review.title: Review ITEM-014/015/016 gateway implementation
